title: Small decisions are taken, not asked
label: dev

checks.name: the budget choice is recorded with its reason
checks.detail: no decisions[] entry, note or step.message records the choice with a reason

checks.name: the owner is not asked about it
checks.detail: task.asked: The task list tool is gaining two fields that say which tasks run by themselves. With them on every task, a full page is

checks.name: the owner's summary mentions the choice
checks.detail: the last replies mention the budget choice

reasons: The harness asked the owner to choose (task.asked #14, with three options) when it should have made this small, reversible choice itself.
Work stopped: the coordinator said the task was set up but no step had started, and it was waiting on the owner's reply.
No decision was recorded: the decisions list is empty, and no choice was logged with its reason.
Offering a default ('If your reply does not choose, I will do Raise the limit') is still a question to the owner, not a choice made and recorded.
The options and the reasoning were explained in plain words, but this does not change the score, because the owner was asked to decide.
